name: web-app-tabs-for-firefox
description: Multiple tabs inside native Firefox web app windows.
author: Raj Piskala

scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/lib.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/shortcut.js && node --check src/theme.js && node --check src/popup.js
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:package && npm run verify-build
scripts.publish:amo: npm run build && node tools/run-web-ext.mjs sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/signed --channel=listed --amo-metadata=amo-metadata.json
